mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing the metabolism of tamoxifen to its active metabolite endoxifen, potentially decreasing tamoxifen efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response to tamoxifen; consider alternative antifungal agents with lower CYP450 inhibition (e.g., fluconazole at lower doses) or adjust tamoxifen dosing if necessary.
